summary: First Phosphate Corp. filed a Form 6-K reporting results of its Annual General and Special Meeting held August 28, 2026. Shareholders elected five directors, fixed board size, appointed auditors, adopted an advance notice policy, and re-approved the omnibus equity incentive plan; all matters passed with over 96% support. The company also noted an 861% increase in registered shareholders to 12,501 from 1,301 in 2025. This is a routine corporate governance update with no special-situation transaction; no deals, premiums, or strategic actions are disclosed.
